name: ask_user
description: Ask the human to choose between concrete options when guessing would waste work: which of two designs to build, which file to change, whether to widen the scope. Only for genuine forks where the options lead to materially different work — do not ask for permission to continue, and do not ask what you can determine by reading the code. Input: {"question": "...", "options": ["...", "..."]} (two or more). Returns the chosen option verbatim. In a non-interactive run it returns an error saying to decide yourself.

options.description: Two or more concrete options, each phrased as the action it leads to.
